FAQ.title: Answers to the questions founders ask most.

accuracy.q: How accurate are the AI-generated business plans?
accuracy.a: ORICO cross-references live market data with proven planning frameworks. Every module is editable, and we surface the assumptions behind every number so you can adjust with confidence.

export.q: What export formats do you support?
export.a: PDF, DOCX and PPTX for plans and pitch decks. Landing pages export as production-ready HTML/CSS. Images are provided as PNG and SVG where applicable.

languages.a: Plans and assets can be generated in over 40 languages, including English, Arabic, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Mandarin.

privacy.a: Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We never train on your content. Enterprise plans include region-locked storage and SSO.

collaboration.q: Can my team collaborate on the same plan?
collaboration.a: Yes. Professional and Enterprise plans include shared workspaces, roles, comments and real-time editing.

refunds.a: Every paid plan starts with a 14-day trial. If ORICO isn't the right fit, cancel any time — no questions asked.
